title: Old Glory Distilling Co.
venue_description:
Old Glory Distilling Co.

A craft Tennessee bourbon and whiskey distillery located in Clarksville featuring a full-service restaurant with scratch-made cuisine and an outdoor Silo Park venue for live music. The distillery crafts all spirits on-site using locally sourced grains and time-honored copper pot distillation methods with sugar maple charcoal filtering.

Music and Events

The Silo Park offers live music every Friday and Saturday from April through November. Friday performances run 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM while Saturday shows run 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM. The Thursday Night Farmers Market runs April 16 through November 5 featuring local vendors live music and food and drinks. The park provides a family-friendly atmosphere with fire pits bocce ball cornhole and ample outdoor seating.

Facilities

The venue includes a professional stage with sound system The Silo Bar serving craft cocktails and the full restaurant available for dine-in service. Distillery tours are available daily. The restaurant hours are Monday through Thursday 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM and Friday through Saturday 11:00 AM to 11:30 PM with Sunday 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

title: Blackhorse Pub & Brewery
venue_description:
Blackhorse Pub & Brewery

Founded in 1992 Blackhorse Pub and Brewery has been an anchor of downtown Clarksville for over three decades. The brewery produces handcrafted ales on-site with the brewing facility located in East Tennessee while the downtown Clarksville location serves as the original pub and taproom.

Music and Entertainment

The upstairs Taproom is open until 3:00 AM and features pool shuffleboard and a full bar. Live music performances occur regularly on weekends. The venue creates an intimate setting for local musicians and visiting acts. The dim lighting and moderate music levels make conversation enjoyable while maintaining a lively atmosphere.

Food and Beverage

The menu features handcrafted ales including Vanilla Cream Ale IPA and seasonal brews paired with pub favorites like beer cheese pizza burgers and sandwiches. Saturday and Sunday brunch is available from 10:30 AM to 2:00 PM featuring Shrimp and Grits the Brewmaster's Breakfast Hangover Burger and Chicken and Waffles plus cocktail specialties. Happy Hour runs daily from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM with discounted beer prices.

title: Tippers Neighborhood Pub
venue_description:
Tippers Neighborhood Pub

A family-owned pub proudly serving Clarksville for over 30 years. Tippers provides a unique vibe with friendly bartenders who remember regular patrons' favorite drinks and create a welcoming atmosphere for everyone. The venue is known for exceptional service and a laid-back community feel.

Music and Entertainment

Live music performances occur most weekends with local musicians and bands taking the stage. Karaoke nights add to the entertainment options. The venue features pool tables and darts creating a full entertainment experience. The spacious layout accommodates both performers and audiences comfortably.

Food and Beverage

The menu features traditional pub fare with particular emphasis on their famous wings available in varieties like Mango Habanero and Parmesan Garlic. Beer is served in mason jars creating a unique presentation. Happy hour specials are available with discounted prices on select drinks and food items. The pub maintains extended hours being open until 3:00 AM most nights.

title: Rookies Sports Bar
venue_description:
Rookies Sports Bar

A lively sports bar and entertainment venue in Clarksville featuring a welcoming atmosphere and diverse crowd. Rookies is known for friendly staff and a community-focused approach to entertainment with reasonable prices and quality food and beverage offerings.

Music and Entertainment

Rookies features local live musicians every Friday and Saturday night bringing regional talent to the venue. Karaoke nights on Fridays provide additional entertainment options. The venue hosts Thursday Night Darts Tournament with sign-ups at 7:00 PM and draw at 7:30 PM. The atmosphere is casual and inviting with bartenders who create personalized drink recommendations for patrons.

Sports and Amenities

The bar boasts 12 HD television screens ensuring every seat provides a great view of the action. Over 30 different beer options including craft and domestic selections are available. The menu features classic pub fare including wings burgers and appetizers at reasonable prices. A large sports-watching community makes this a popular destination during major sporting events.

title: Scooter's Place
venue_description:
Scooter's Place

A bar and grill hosting regular live music performances in Clarksville. Scooter's Place is known for its friendly staff lively atmosphere and welcoming vibe where customers report always having a great time. The venue attracts both locals and visitors seeking entertainment and good company.

Music and Entertainment

Live band performances occur regularly throughout the week with weekend shows being particularly popular. Local bands perform covers of country rock and southern rock hits. The venue also features karaoke creating additional entertainment options. Recent performances have included local favorites covering hits from male and female country artists with rock and southern rock selections.

Food and Beverage

Scooter's Place operates as a full-service bar and grill with extended hours. The friendly staff and good-natured atmosphere make it a popular hangout spot. The venue is open from noon to 3:00 AM most days with extended Saturday hours. The spacious layout accommodates both performers and audiences making it suitable for various group sizes.

title: Mike's Bar and Grill
venue_description:
Mike's Bar and Grill

A vibrant bar and grill in Clarksville known for its inviting atmosphere diverse menu and lively entertainment. The venue provides excellent service with attentive bartenders creating memorable drink experiences. The layout features multiple entertainment options making it ideal for various occasions.

Music and Entertainment

Mike's hosts live music performances regularly with local bands covering country rock and classic hits. The venue features 7 flat-screen TVs and a 125-inch projector screen perfect for watching major sporting events and performances. The bar includes 2 pool tables and 2 dart boards for additional entertainment. A spacious patio area extends the venue and provides outdoor entertainment space.

Food and Beverage

The menu offers a full selection of pub food including burgers sandwiches and appetizers. Happy Hour runs Tuesday through Sunday from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM featuring domestic beers for $2 and well drinks for $2.50. The 2-ounce pour for the price of a single offering applies to all single-liquor cocktails during happy hour. Extended hours and convenient location make this a popular gathering spot.
